{{Quote|From now on, we give Kugg ''nothing''!''"<br />"''That's ''Governor'' Kugg, if you don't mind, Head Councilman!|Head Councilman Althon and Governor Kugg|<ref name="Droids (1986) 1">[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Head Councilman''' was the title given to the leader of the [[Citizen's Council of Dodz]]. Early in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Althon]] was the Head Councilman, but he and his fellows were powerless pawns in [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kugg]]'s tyrannical reign over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]]. Any attempt they made to defy Kugg resulted in Kugg's [[Destroyer (droid)|Destroyer droid]] wreaking havoc. However, Althon took Kugg into custody when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by a [[Ranger X-One defense robot]].
